module Test.FeatureIntegration.Negative.BadInvariant

function bad_invariant(max: Integer) returns Integer
is
    let current: Integer = 0
    while current < max
    invariant
    variant max - current
    do
        current := current + 1
    end while
    return current
end bad_invariant

end Test.FeatureIntegration.Negative.BadInvariant
